candidates.name: Specialty Installations & Sales, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Site lists toilet compartments as a main product line and says 'We provide A+ Installation within the State of Florida'. Measures projects and quotes from plans.
red_flags: Dealer for many partition makers (Bobrick, Scranton, Metpar and others), so it can supply the partitions itself: high buy-around risk
Based in Port Richey, about 35 miles north of the area centre; installs statewide in Florida
candidates.reason: Specialty supplier and installer since 1979 with toilet compartments and Florida installation stated on its own site. Strong fit for installation, but it is also a competing partitions dealer.
